what: Color panels stick to the screen in turn, and the next panel rises from below to cover the one before. While the next panel rises by one screen height, the panel beneath gets its own color veil that deepens by progress² so its text fades (first panel: starts after 42% and spans 42%, the others span 50%). If a panel is taller than the screen, it sticks only after being read to the end.
use:
Panel 1
Panel 2
…
— panel background is var(--tone)

from.where: index.js stacked() .story-overlay --sticky-top · --cover (color panel for vertical reading on phone)
